sar.narrative: Between 2016-12-02 19:00 and 2016-12-02 19:30, 4 transaction(s) totalling $1,904.86 were made on card(s) C02265-K1 belonging to customer C02265. The activity comprised 4 online transaction(s) under product code(s) C, in billing region 308. Online transactions came from device profile(s) Windows | Windows 10 | chrome 64.0 | 1920x1080. The purchases were placed within minutes of each other, each just below a $500 threshold, a pattern that avoids single-transaction limits. When contacted: Customer states they did not make the $469.47 transaction and still has the card (simulated). The same burst shape was found on 9 cards of 9 different customers in the preceding 30 days, indicating coordinated abuse (policy R9). The amount exceeds the $1,000 reporting threshold. Total suspicious amount: $1,904.86. Actions recommended: BLOCK_CARD, CREATE_CASE, FILE_REPORT, ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST.
